statement: Reasonix ACP uses an NDJSON JSON-RPC 2.0 connection over stdin/stdout, runs requests and notifications concurrently, maps engine events to session updates, and forwards gated tool decisions as client permission requests.

display_text.zh-CN: Reasonix ACP 通过 stdin/stdout 使用 NDJSON JSON-RPC 2.0 connection，并发处理 request/notification，把 engine events 映射为 session updates，并把受控工具决策转发为 client permission request。
display_text.en: Reasonix ACP uses an NDJSON JSON-RPC 2.0 connection over stdin/stdout, runs requests and notifications concurrently, maps engine events to session updates, and forwards gated tool decisions as client permission requests.

evidence.title: Reasonix ACP event and approval projection

notes: Protocol interoperability with a real editor client remains an explicit experiment gap.
